Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets Josef Weber, a man from a local emotional support group. Slowly, an improbable friendship begins to blossom between them within the heart of the bakery.

However, everything changes in the day Josef shares a deep-buried secret that nobody in the town could ever suspect. He asks Sage for an extraordinary favor. If she accepts, she will not only confront serious moral repercussions but also potential legal challenges.

Suddenly, with her own identity thrown into question, Sage begins to doubt the life and family she thought she knew.
